15. (Currently amended) A method of selecting a server computer for sending data to a client computer, the method comprising the steps of: accessing a server computer through a path in a computer network, the path including one or more server computers; adding information indicative of at least one server computer of the first set of one or more server computers to a locator of a resource on the second server computer, __the information being provided to a media request broker__, the resource having a unique signature as part of its identifier; and selecting the first server computer based on the information added to the locator __by the media request broker in response to receiving the information from the client computer__.

16. (Currently amended) The method of claim 15, the second server computer being a Web application server comprising a Web page with a hyperlink referencing the data to be sent to the client computer, the hyperlink including a unique signature, the method further comprising the steps of selecting the hyperlink by the client computer, and subsequently generating an http request out of this hyperlink by a web browser, this http request containing the unique signature identifying a media request, __wherein the media request broker receives the http request from the client computer and selects the first server computer based on the unique signature and the information__.

18. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, __the media request broker receiving information from the client computer and__ selecting the first server computer based on the information __received from the client computer__.
